title: Zuhdi and the Stony Ground
logline: Zuhdi plants a hidden seed in Sidqi, the hardest ground of all.
story: Nothing had ever grown in Sidqi, who was a man of observant quiet, seeking a melody within his own silence — ground so hard the others laughed when Zuhdi, who carried olive farmer, the steady root that feeds, was handed a single seed and told to plant it there. Zuhdi did not argue; Zuhdi simply returned each day to tend the barren place. No green came for a long season, and still Zuhdi watered the stone. Then one morning a thread of root had split the rock from within. What force could not break, patience had quietly opened.
moral: What force cannot break, steady and patient tending opens from within.
